User Journey: Map results to dashboard

_As a user, I need to know my work will be saved when I navigate away from the results page after completing the mapping process so that I can be confident in the product and that I will not lose my work._

Features/acceptance Criteria:

Dashboard button in the universal navigation bar.

Auto

save text with tick, possibly under the back button in the dark blue area so they see it when about to navigate away via back or dashboard.

Back button in the sub

bar area with the 3 wizard process steps, so the user understands that the back button takes them back one page in this process.

New Map button (in the universal navigation bar

only visible on the results page (not the other wizard pages) takes them to the dashboard with the wizard expanded and the curser in the search entry field.

{panel:bgColor=#fffae6} _We may need to consider what happens if the user attempts to navigate to the dahsboard before completing the wizard - ie. a pop up informing them if they have not finished the mapping process, it will not be saved._ {panel}
